en: Black-and-white photograph showing a procession of riders on horseback in elaborate, historical-style uniforms with plumed helmets crossing a narrow bridge toward a fortified gate. The gate is part of a large stuccoed building with many rectangular windows and a tiled roof. Above the arched gateway is an ornate baroque coat of arms flanked by two lions and surmounted by a row of crowns or plumes. People on foot follow the riders through the gate. The image has the appearance of an old printed postcard, with some handwritten or printed marks at the very top edge.
